name: io.github.AntVsl/oura-mcp
title: Oura Ring
description: Sleep, readiness, HRV, resting heart rate, activity and stress from your Oura Ring

environmentVariables.name: OURA_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of your Oura application from developer.ouraring.com

environmentVariables.name: OURA_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret of your Oura application

environmentVariables.name: OURA_REDIRECT_URI
environmentVariables.description: OAuth redirect URI; must match the Oura application byte for byte

environmentVariables.name: OURA_API_MODE
environmentVariables.description: sandbox for Oura's synthetic data (no auth needed), production for your own

environmentVariables.name: OURA_TZ
environmentVariables.description: IANA timezone deciding what counts as today. Set it explicitly on servers, whose clocks run in UTC

environmentVariables.name: OURA_TOKEN_STORE
environmentVariables.description: Where the OAuth flow stores tokens. Written by the server, not set by hand

environmentVariables.name: OURA_PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public https address, without a trailing slash. Enables OAuth 2.1 for Claude.ai and ChatGPT; leave empty for local or Bearer-token clients

environmentVariables.name: OURA_OAUTH_ALLOWED_REDIRECT_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated trusted OAuth redirect origins; defaults to Claude.ai and ChatGPT

environmentVariables.name: OURA_MCP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Shared secret guarding the HTTP endpoint. Required whenever the server binds to anything other than loopback; without it the server refuses to start

environmentVariables.name: OURA_PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public https address, without a trailing slash. Enables OAuth 2.1 for Claude.ai and ChatGPT; leave empty for local or Bearer-token clients

environmentVariables.name: OURA_OAUTH_ALLOWED_REDIRECT_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated trusted OAuth redirect origins; defaults to Claude.ai and ChatGPT
